title: AION 2 Templar: Skills, Tanking and PvE Builds
description: Learn Templar skills, Judgment triggers, threat management, Stigma choices and safe Punishment windows for solo play, dungeons and PvP.
summary: Build a shield-based frontline character around Judgment triggers, Punishment, threat and timed protection.
quickAnswer: Templar uses a sword and shield. Connect shield skills to Judgment, use Pummel to shorten Punishment with its selected option, and keep Taunt and manual protection ready when tanking.
